notes.title: Hello, everyone, Future Simulation World has been updated to 0.71Ab
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894801/38b3e2537d6cb8bbcb9dcb86fc69bf4416bea382.png[/img]
·Several parameters are added to better reflect the real situation of the current society:
Gini coefficient - reflecting the current situation of the gap between the rich and the poor
Unemployment rate - the number of people who have not yet worked in a given period of time
Life expectancy of population

·Added Global Mission: better game guidance and feedback

·Reduce the trigger frequency of the whole event

·The game start time will be adjusted to 2021, and the basic data will be adjusted accordingly

·Changed cohesion formula: now cohesion is related to per capita GDP and annual growth rate of per capita GDP

·Adjusted and balanced almost all data

·Optimized and improved the overall game experience

The game is still in the first trial
Bug, balance and game problems may exist, please forgive thx
If you have any questions or ideas, please come up with them. Thank you for your support

About the next update:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894801/fb54950fc64490b1e3504515c408d8d51c1f1b0d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894801/44e0c156c1e894cd22c1c038338dbbcd6a4d618b.png[/img][/url] (Almost, doing; progress: 0%)
Strive to launch a new model in this year, pay more attention to the game and playability, maybe reduce the game process properly? (uncertain)
The standard frame mode of the current game is more like scenario mode, and there is not much choice space

·English version in production
